name: Amazon Woman
caption: The OWA's reigning World Champion through the winter of 1995, defending the title on live weekly television and headlining WinterTime Massacre.

tenures.note: Billed as OWA World Champion throughout; retained the title against Dangerous Dunk, Traci Lane, and Ricky Blood across December 1995. Continued as a top OWA star through 1996: lost the title to Pretty Boy Monty (11 January), won and lost the OWA TV, InterNet, and OWA Tag Team Championships across the year, and was retired by the promotion's own stipulation after a 1996-12-31 loss to Freddy Fever, becoming the first OWA Hall of Fame inductee the same night.

tenures.source: the fed's own 7 July 2002 Naughty or Nice broadcast, which bills her by her real ring name, "former OWA great... Amazon Woman," confirms her for the fed's own September special, and has her run in on a tag match

name: Colt

tenures.source: InterNet Wrestling Pro, 2 December 1995, debut-tournament broadcast (rec.sport.pro-wrestling.fantasy)
tenures.note: Won the debut InterNet Championship tournament, lost the title to Ricky Blood on 14 December, and claimed on-air to have taken it back by 29 December. Continued into 1996, challenging JetStream for the InterNet Championship he once held (a no-contest, dated by internal evidence to April 1996) and defeating Sabin Figaro on 20 April 1996.

identity.note: A shared ring name only; no roster, date, or storyline overlap with the other held wing's own Colt.

name: Ricky Blood
caption: A member of the villainous stable The Family who won the InterNet Championship from Colt and challenged for the OWA World Championship at WinterTime Massacre.

tenures.note: Won the InterNet Championship from Colt on 14 December 1995; advanced to the OWA World Championship main event at WinterTime Massacre by forfeit.

name: Traci Lane

tenures.source: InterNet Wrestling Pro, 2 December 1995, debut-tournament broadcast (rec.sport.pro-wrestling.fantasy)
tenures.note: Runner-up in the debut InterNet Championship tournament; challenged for the OWA World Championship on 14 December and was eliminated last from the WinterTime Massacre lottery match. Continued as a top OWA star through 1996: won the OWA Championship from Pretty Boy Monty at Endurance's Evil Challenge (1 February), and won the 1996 Wheel of Torture tournament at Halloween Horror, taking the deciding seventh fall over Amazon Woman. Retained the OWA Championship in a Triangle Ladder match over Anthony Hazard and Pretty Boy Monty at Crime Spree, 2 May 1997, the last card in the held record.

identity.note: Name collision only: a same-named entity in another wing (tholian-black-widow); no shared operator, chronology or storyline evidence in this wing's documents.

name: Dangerous Dunk

name: Pretty Boy Monty

tenures.note: Installed as Rocket's OWA Tag Team Championship partner by commissioner decree, then defeated "Pretty Boy" Johnny Stallion at WinterTime Massacre. Challenged for the OWA Championship in the Triangle Ladder match main event at Crime Spree, 2 May 1997, the last card in the held record.

Lost, teamed with a returning Biff Franklin, to Taleis & Ricky Hype at Crime Spree, 2 May 1997; The Chiefs' OWA Tag Team Championship reign had already ended, undocumented, by this point.
